A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GeoPurify and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. The retained material and renumbered appendices can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original GeoPurify segmentation, cross-dataset generalization, ablation and qualitative results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds training-subset-size and subset-selection experiments in Tables 4 and 11.

M1.justification: The X-Decoder backbone, Sonata teacher, student architecture, contrastive objective, hybrid sampling and geometry-guided pooling remain unchanged. The additional subset-selection experiments test alternatives without replacing the proposed pipeline or Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ScanNetV2, ScanNet200 and Matterport3D, including the same expanded-vocabulary and cross-dataset scenarios. The new experiments vary training subsets within existing coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds OV3D and PGOV3D as evaluated comparison methods, both listed with 100% training data. Existing comparators remain; the other benchmark comparison tables retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: New experiments vary ScanNetV2 training size across 10, 20, 30 and 50 scenes and compare heuristic selection with uniform random selection and coordinate-and-color clustering. Existing splits, metrics, training settings and default 20-scene configuration remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 4 adds a focused data-quantity sensitivity analysis. New Appendix C and Table 11 test whether performance depends on ground-truth-guided scene selection. Earlier component ablations, transfer analyses and qualitative failure cases are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added subset experiments continue the existing single-value reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing result values remain unchanged. New full-data Table 1 entries include ScanNetV2 mIoU/mAcc of 57.3/72.9 for OV3D and 59.5/73.2 for PGOV3D. Table 4 adds subset-size results spanning 54.7–55.1 mIoU; Table 11 reports 54.6 and 54.9 for random and coordinate-and-color selection versus 55.1 for the heuristic. These are additional comparisons and settings, not improved scores for the unchanged default method.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 and the subset-selection algorithm retain the same mathematical content. No formal assumptions, propositions, proofs or derivations are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The central claims about recovering latent geometry, annotation-free distillation and competitive performance using approximately 1.5% of training data remain. The introduction reorganizes the contribution statements and emphasizes latent-structure recovery without changing their substantive scope; the abstract's scientific claims and conclusion are retained.

C2.justification: v2 expands the explanation of low-data robustness through decoupled geometric denoising. It interprets the subset-size plateau as a semantic-backbone bottleneck and the selection experiments as evidence against dependence on curated scenes. Existing over-smoothing and inherited semantic-error limitations remain in the relocated qualitative appendix.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 newly specifies that the 3D point space is constructed from multi-view projections without requiring external raw point clouds at inference. This is additional documentation, not an established procedure change. Appendix A's architecture, subset identifiers and hyperparameters remain unchanged; the existing repository link is relocated.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Open3DIS, Xu et al.'s unified framework and PGOV3D. Section 2 adds a specific contrast between OV3D/PGOV3D's data requirements and GeoPurify's latent-affinity recovery, while retaining the broader research positioning.

P1.justification: The introduction and contribution bullets receive localized rewrites, and several experimental explanations are expanded. Acknowledgments and conference header text are added. New Appendix C shifts the previous qualitative and LLM-use appendices to D and E; the overall organization remains recognizable.

P2.justification: Tables 1 and 4 expand, Table 4 moves before its discussion, and Table 11 is added. Appendix figures are reflowed; Figures 2 and 6 receive small graphical adjustments, including revised arrows and failure-region highlighting, while retaining the same pipeline and examples.

improvement.justification: The new subset-size and annotation-free selection controls strengthen support for data efficiency and reduce concern about dependence on label-guided curation. Adding OV3D and PGOV3D also broadens the comparison. These gains are limited by absent run variability and unchanged Section 4.2 claims of mAcc superiority that no longer match the expanded Table 1, whose new full-data competitors exceed GeoPurify's low-data ScanNetV2 accuracy.
